title: Stateful Trait Parameters
description: Configuration contract for the Stateful trait's status machine.

states.description: Ordered list of lifecycle states available to consumers.

items.description: Case-sensitive state identifier; source enum values retain their spelling.

initialState.description: State assigned when an entity is created.

transitionRules.description: Allowed state transition map. Keys are source states; values are arrays of permitted target states, and an empty array marks a final state. Null means open model (all transitions allowed).

actions.description: Named moves a person makes on a record, each to one state of the declared order: a generated screen offers each only from the states it moves from, and a generated app writes it as one change. Each needs transitionRules.

id.description: The action's id, unique on the object ("revoke").

to.description: The state the action moves the record to.

from.description: The states it is offered from; by default every state whose declared targets include `to`.

verb.description: The verb a person reads on its button ("Revoke").

event.description: The event Timestampable records for it, one of its recordedEvents.

reasonField.description: The field its optional note is written to.

bySeat.description: The seat whose _id, _name and _kind fields name who acted, when the app is told.

confirm.description: When true, the action asks once, stating what it ends and what goes on, before it is written.

alsoEnds.description: Records of the same object whose `via` names this one make the same move with it, each with its own line.

requireTransitionReason.description: When true, every state transition must include a human-readable reason.
